news.title: Protests across Buxar over PMAY-Gramin beneficiary list
news.para: Villagers and public representatives in Buxar district protested against the provisional beneficiary list of PMAY-G. They alleged that deserving families were excluded while affluent households were wrongly included in the list. Public representatives demanded a fresh review of the list and transparency in the verification process. Officials stated that the verification of beneficiaries is ongoing and that objections will be examined.

news.title: Adani begins construction of 10,432 Dharavi rehabilitation homes in Mumbai
news.para: Pranav Adani conducted the bhoomi poojan for a transformative housing project designed to rehabilitate residents of Dharavi. This significant undertaking will consist of 10 towers that house 10,432 apartments and 1,379 commercial units across an expansive 22 acres. As part of the in-situ rehabilitation scheme, qualifying residents will benefit from 350 square feet homes, complete with contemporary amenities to uplift family living standards.

news.title: India office net absorption rises 2% to 42.9 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Net office absorption across India’s top seven cities rose 2% year-on-year to 42.9 million sq ft during January-September 2026. Coworking emerged as the largest occupier segment with a 26% share, while office vacancy declined to 15.15% and average rentals increased 8%.

news.title: Shree Cement commissions three MTPA grinding unit in UAE with AED 115 million investment
news.para: Shree Cement has commissioned a 3 MTPA cement grinding facility at its subsidiary Union Cement Company in Ras Al Khaimah, taking its UAE cement capacity to 7 MTPA from 4 MTPA and overall capacity to 76.3 MTPA.

news.title: Puravankara pre-sales rise 62% to ₹2,136 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Puravankara reported pre-sales of ₹2,136 crore in Q2 FY27, up 62% year-on-year, while collections increased 24% to ₹1,301 crore. The company added projects with estimated GDV of ₹8,900 crore during the quarter and ₹14,100 crore in H1 FY27.

news.title: Pune civic body to levy extra property tax on developers of illegal constructions as penalty
news.para: In Pune, developers engaged in unlawful construction practices will now incur extra penalties on their property taxes. The Pune Municipal Corporation intends to use these additional funds to offset demolition costs. Although notices have been dispatched, compliance is significantly lacking, compounded by a strong demand for affordable housing and insufficient local authority supervision. Experts warn that these collection strategies may fail without proper recovery of outstanding dues.

news.title: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, BGO target $1 billion real estate portfolio
news.para: The plan to deploy more capital comes as developers increasingly turn to institutional investors for structured capital amid regulatory changes, sector consolidation and stronger balance sheets among leading players.

news.title: Delhi development body offers 2,516 LIG flats in Narela at 25% discount
news.para: Delhi Development Authority is initiating a new housing scheme for low-income group flats in Narela. The scheme offers 2,516 flats with a 25% discount, starting at around Rs 15 lakh. Registration for the scheme will open on October 14, followed by booking on October 20. A non-refundable registration fee of Rs 2,500 will be charged during the onboarding process.

news.title: Gurugram: DTCP flags building plan violations in Uniworld Garden-1
news.para: The residents' welfare association of Uniworld Garden-1, located in Gurgaon, is seeking more time to respond to a show-cause notice issued by the department of town and country planning regarding alleged building plan deviations. Complaints detail unauthorized constructions and misuse of green areas. The association plans to gather additional evidence before crafting a detailed response and has requested a personal hearing to clarify the raised concerns.

news.title: Apartment owners in Bengaluru await new law, meet Karnataka governor
news.para: The Bangalore Apartments Federation engaged in discussions with governor Thaawar Chand Gehlot to emphasize the significance of the KAOMA bill. This initiative is designed to secure apartment ownership and better protect shared spaces for owners. Many residents are keen for these new provisions to establish clear rights and obligations for apartment owners.

news.title: Kolte-Patil Developers sales rise 52% to ₹1,019 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Kolte-Patil Developers reported its highest-ever quarterly sales of ₹1,019 crore in Q2 FY27, while H1 FY27 sales rose 27% to ₹1,636 crore. The company also added six redevelopment projects in MMR with combined estimated GDV of ₹6,000 crore.

news.title: Builders cannot transfer project‑related costs to buyers: Karnataka RERA
news.para: The Karnataka Real Estate Regulatory Authority (K-RERA) has declared that builders are prohibited from imposing GST on domestic water charges. This ruling compels a builder to rectify incorrect GST applications on a buyer's bill. K-RERA asserted that developers must cover all costs related to the project until ownership passes.

news.title: Greater Noida: Plumeria Garden & Migsun Ultimo get a month to procure fire NOCs
news.para: Residents residing in the Plumeria Garden and Migsun Ultimo societies of Greater Noida have been granted a one-month extension to secure their fire safety no objection certificates from the Greater Noida Authority. This reprieve comes after concerns were raised over the previous power disconnection threat due to missing documentation. Ongoing discussions with Authority officials aim to clarify compliance expectations and improve community engagement regarding fire safety measures.

news.title: Ghaziabad administration to auction properties of nine RERA defaulters to recover dues
news.para: The Ghaziabad district administration plans to auction the properties of nine prominent Rera defaulters soon. The auction kicks off on October 16 with two properties, including shops in Kaushambi, followed by seven more slated for November 6 at various locations. This strategy seeks to recover outstanding debts from 62 identified defaulters, as officials engage in necessary legal proceedings to ensure successful asset recovery.

news.title: ED attaches ₹140 crore assets of Earth Infrastructure, its promoters in ₹2,004 crore money laundering case
news.para: In a stern move, the Enforcement Directorate has seized assets valued at Rs 140 crore tied to Earth Infrastructure Ltd and its promoters, amid an extensive investigation into a Rs 2,004 crore money laundering scheme. The promoters stand accused of scamming over 19,000 homebuyers by failing to deliver on property promises.

news.title: India office leasing flat at 66.7 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026; GCC share rises to 41%: Report
news.para: Office leasing across India’s top eight markets stood at 66.7 million sq ft in the first nine months of 2026, broadly unchanged year-on-year. GCC leasing rose 10.4% to 27.4 million sq ft, while new office completions increased 50% to 48.6 million sq ft.

news.title: UP RERA extends QPR filing deadline to October 21; makes DSC-based certificates mandatory
news.para: UP RERA has extended the deadline for filing quarterly progress reports for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to October 21. Promoters will now have to submit digitally signed REG-1, REG-2 and REG-3 certificates along with the QPR.

news.title: Many vacant plots encroached; Indirapuram residents write to Ghaziabad development body, demand action
news.para: Residents of Indirapuram are raising concerns about the encroachment on plots allotted by Ghaziabad Development Authority. They claim that around 20% of these plots are illegally occupied and affecting community security. The Indirapuram Welfare Association has demanded action from the GDA regarding unauthorized occupations and connections. Residents have requested a six-month notice for plot owners to start construction or face eviction.

news.title: Puravankara to jointly develop 12.76-acre land in Bengaluru
news.para: Puravankara has signed a joint development agreement for a 12.76-acre land parcel in Sathanur, North Bengaluru. The proposed residential project has an estimated saleable area of 1.90 million sq ft and potential GDV of ₹2,500 crore.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh CM virtually launches house title distribution in Nellore
news.para: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu officially kicked off the distribution of permanent house titles to 939 families, a significant initiative worth around Rs 600 crore. This follows prior efforts where 60,000 families received titles encompassing properties valued at Rs 52,000 crore. The government is also focused on enhancing essential infrastructure along with housing provisions for low-income families.
